notes.title: Halloween Update 0.18f Release
notes.content:
This Halloween night, we're bringing you the monthly update 0.18f. For this version, we took inspiration from our other game, Just Life, and added a simplified farming system. Now, you can find 14 types of seeds and shops where you can buy and sell everything you need to start your own harvest.

As mentioned, it’s a simple system that adds a new way to earn money in the game. This is not a farming game but rather a game that includes farming mechanics to diversify the gameplay. However, if the community wants more depth in this system, we're open to considering it in future updates.

[previewyoutube=Ygj0fKOX8Dg;full][/previewyoutube]

Update Details:

[list]
[*] Fixed a bug that affected certain interactions when changing clothes.
[*] Added the option to run at full speed.
[*] New stores: tools, fruits and vegetables, and seed sales.
[*] Added a backyard.
[*] Introduced a simplified farming system.
[/list]

We appreciate your continuous support and will keep working hard to bring you the best game possible.

notes.title: Update 0.17f and Special Discount!
notes.content:
Today, we bring you two pieces of great news. First, update 0.17f is now available, which is a major update adding the first week of story mode, and second, we are celebrating this with a 30% discount on the game!

The game has evolved significantly over the past 9 months since its release. Initially, it was supposed to be just a mini-game collection, but it has grown into something much bigger.

[previewyoutube=RoGx4ESTw6w;full][/previewyoutube]

[previewyoutube=5sUFUh-V9Hw;full][/previewyoutube]


We will be updating the game's roadmap, with the following improvements planned:

[list]
[*] New mini-games
[*] Adding facial expressions to dialogues
[*] Custom music for each cutscene
[*] NPC routines
[*] Adding the ability to read a complete book (public domain)
[*] Crafting system
[*] New locations such as the city center, karaoke, bowling alley, and another arcade hall.
[/list]

These improvements are short-term and should be included in the next three updates.


Current update details:

[list]
[*] The first week of the story mode has been added.
[*] Bug fixes.
[*] School classes have been added.
[*] The skill system has been improved.
[*] The interior of the school has been revamped and expanded.
[*] New NPCs and key characters for the story have been added.
[/list]

Thank you for your support! We will continue to work hard to bring you the best possible game.

notes.title: Great Update 0.15f Now Available! And Updated Demo
notes.content:
After a long time and hard work, this great game update is now available. It took longer than budgeted, but it was worth it. Many bugs were fixed, various areas were improved, and the story mode finally started. To celebrate, we have published a half-hour gameplay on YouTube covering the first day of the game.

The game demo has also been updated, now giving access to all mini-games and the mall area. You can play without limits, but you will not be able to explore other areas of the game.

[previewyoutube=PrtfwlzJYzc;full][/previewyoutube]

Here are the details of the changes in version 0.15f:

[list]
[*] New interaction events with Reiko (cinema, clothing store, fitting room) were created.
[*] Cutscenes were added for all these new events.
[*] New dialogues between Reiko and the protagonist.
[*] Now Reiko and the protagonist can try on clothes in the fitting rooms.
[*] New stores were added to the mall (café, gym, men's clothing store, music store).
[*] A minimap was added.
[*] Sound was added to the protagonist's footsteps.
[*] Small voice phrases were added to Reiko.
[*] Translation in different languages was improved.
[*] The game size was significantly reduced to less than half.
[*] Lighting corrections were made in various scenes.
[*] Several bugs were fixed.
[*] Minor corrections.
[/list]


The interior of the school was removed in this version, as it is currently being modified and expanded, and will be ready for the next game version. The next update should not take as long. Thank you for your support, and we will continue to work hard to complete the game.

notes.content:

notes.content:

notes.title: Roadmap Update and Thanks to the Play Minigames with Reiko Community
notes.content:
Dear Play Minigames with Reiko Community!

We want to express our sincere gratitude to all of you who have been supporting this project.
We want to share with you the exciting roadmap we have planned:

Phase 1: World Foundations
• Complete the Main Story.
• Introduce Events that add excitement and surprises to the game.
• Explore Side Quests for those seeking additional challenges.
• Discover New Locations:
City Center
Metro Station
School
Temple
Convenience Store
Library

Phase 2: Expansion and Enhancements

• Implement New Features that will enrich the gaming experience:
Functional Phone for unique interactions.
Photo Mode to capture memorable moments.
Functional Computer for virtual activities.
Changes in the Protagonist's Room Decor to personalize their space.
• Introduce New Minigames for even more fun.
• Offer New Part-Time Jobs to explore different job opportunities.
• Develop Skills for the main character.
• Establish Routines for NPCs, creating a more dynamic world.
• Pose exciting Challenges to keep players engaged.

We are committed to working tirelessly to deliver a game that exceeds your expectations. Thank you for being part of this thrilling adventure!
